title: Health and Advice
description: Menjelaskan gejala sakit, memberi saran dengan should/shouldn't, serta membicarakan kewajiban dan aturan dengan have to, don't have to, must, dan mustn't.
objectives: Menyebutkan bagian tubuh, penyakit ringan, dan gejala
Memberi saran dengan should dan shouldn't
Membicarakan kewajiban dengan have to / don't have to
Memahami aturan dengan must / mustn't dan membedakannya dari don't have to

lessons.title: What's the Matter? Body and Illnesses
lessons.summary: Kosakata bagian tubuh, penyakit, dan cara menjelaskan gejala.
objectives: Menggunakan kosakata bagian tubuh dan penyakit umum
Menjelaskan gejala dengan I have a..., My ... hurts, dan I feel...
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Menanyakan keadaan
Untuk menanyakan apa yang sakit, kita memakai:
- **What's the matter?** (Ada apa? / Kenapa?)
- **What's wrong?** (Apa yang salah?)
- **Are you OK?**

### Tiga pola untuk menjelaskan gejala
| Pola | Contoh | Arti |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **I have a/an** + penyakit | *I have a headache.* | Saya sakit kepala. |
| **My** + bagian tubuh + **hurts** | *My back hurts.* | Punggung saya sakit. |
| **I feel** + adjective | *I feel sick / dizzy / tired.* | Saya merasa mual / pusing / lelah. |

Untuk bagian tubuh jamak, pakai **hurt** tanpa -s: *My feet hurt.* Di masa lalu: *My knee hurt yesterday.* (hurt tidak berubah).

### Penyakit dan gejala umum
| English | Indonesia |
| --- | --- |
| a headache | sakit kepala |
| a stomachache | sakit perut |
| a toothache | sakit gigi |
| a backache | sakit punggung |
| a sore throat | sakit tenggorokan |
| a cold | pilek, flu ringan |
| the flu | flu (influenza) |
| a cough | batuk |
| a fever / a temperature | demam |
| dizzy | pusing (berputar) |

### Bagian tubuh
*head* (kepala), *throat* (tenggorokan), *chest* (dada), *stomach* (perut), *back* (punggung), *shoulder* (bahu), *arm* (lengan), *knee* (lutut), *ankle* (pergelangan kaki), *foot/feet* (kaki/telapak kaki).

### Kesalahan khas penutur Indonesia
Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita berkata *kepala saya sakit*. Dalam bahasa Inggris, jangan katakan ✗ *My head is sick*. Gunakan **I have a headache** atau **My head hurts**.

Kata **sick** biasanya berarti *sakit* secara umum (*I'm sick today*) atau *mual* (*I feel sick* = saya mual). Jangan pakai *sick* untuk satu bagian tubuh.

### Menceritakan sakit di masa lalu
Gunakan past simple: *Last week I had the flu. I had a high temperature and I didn't go to work.*

lessons.title: Should and Shouldn't for Advice
lessons.summary: Memberi dan meminta saran dengan should dan shouldn't.
objectives: Memberi saran dengan should / shouldn't + base verb
Meminta saran dengan Should I...? dan What should I do?
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Should = sebaiknya
Kita memakai **should** untuk memberi **saran** (*advice*) — sesuatu yang menurut kita **ide yang baik**.

*You **should** see a doctor.* (Sebaiknya kamu periksa ke dokter.)
*You **shouldn't** eat so much sugar.* (Sebaiknya kamu tidak makan terlalu banyak gula.)

### Pola
| Bentuk | Pola | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Positif | subject + **should** + base verb | *You should rest.* |
| Negatif | subject + **shouldn't** (should not) + base verb | *You shouldn't go to work.* |
| Pertanyaan | **Should** + subject + base verb? | *Should I take this medicine?* |
| Pertanyaan wh- | Wh- + **should** + subject + base verb? | *What should I do?* |

### Aturan penting
1. **Should** sama untuk semua subjek: *I should, she should, they should* (✗ *she shoulds*).
2. Setelah should langsung **bentuk dasar** tanpa *to*: ✗ *You should to rest.* ✓ *You should rest.*
3. Bentuk negatif: **shouldn't**, bukan ✗ *don't should*.

### Membuat saran terdengar lebih halus
Dalam bahasa Inggris, saran langsung kadang terdengar terlalu keras. Tambahkan **I think** atau **Maybe**:
- *I think you should stay at home today.*
- *Maybe you should drink some warm tea.*
- *I don't think you should go out.* (lebih natural daripada *I think you shouldn't...*)

### Saran untuk masalah kesehatan
| Masalah | Saran |
| --- | --- |
| I have a cold. | You should drink lots of water and rest. |
| I have a toothache. | You should see a dentist. |
| I can't sleep. | You shouldn't drink coffee in the evening. |
| I have a backache. | You shouldn't carry heavy things. |

### Perbedaan dengan bahasa Indonesia
*Sebaiknya* atau *seharusnya* dalam bahasa Indonesia bisa diletakkan di awal kalimat. Dalam bahasa Inggris, **should** selalu ada **setelah subjek**: *You should...*, bukan ✗ *Should you rest* (itu pertanyaan).

examples.en: You should drink lots of water when you have a fever.
examples.id: Sebaiknya kamu minum banyak air saat demam.

examples.en: You shouldn't stay up late before an exam.
examples.id: Sebaiknya kamu tidak begadang sebelum ujian.

examples.en: Should I call the doctor? — Yes, I think you should.
examples.id: Haruskah saya menelepon dokter? — Ya, menurut saya sebaiknya begitu.

examples.en: I don't think you should go swimming with a cold.
examples.id: Menurut saya kamu sebaiknya tidak berenang saat pilek.

vocabulary.example: Can you give me some advice?
You should rest for a few days.
You shouldn't stay up late on weekdays.
You should see a dentist twice a year.
Drink some warm water with honey.

grammar.note: Sama untuk semua subjek, tanpa to.
Short answer: Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.

grammar.pattern: I think / I don't think + subject + should ...
grammar.example: I don't think you should drive today.

mistakes.wrong: You should to see a dentist.
mistakes.why: Setelah should langsung bentuk dasar, tanpa to.
Negatif dari should adalah shouldn't, tanpa do.

sections.summary: **should / shouldn't + base verb** untuk memberi saran. Pertanyaan: *Should I...? / What should I do?* Jangan pakai *to* atau *-s* setelah should. Tambahkan *I think* atau *Maybe* agar saran lebih halus.

reviewCards.back: Tidak! You should rest (bukan should to rest).

questions.prompt: Choose the best advice: You have a high fever. You ___ go to work today.
questions.explanation: Saat demam tinggi, bekerja bukan ide yang baik → shouldn't.

questions.explanation: Minum banyak air = ide baik → should. Begadang = ide buruk → shouldn't.

questions.sentence: It's a good idea to wear a helmet on a motorbike.
answers: You should wear a helmet on a motorbike.
questions.explanation: It's a good idea to... = You should + base verb.

questions.explanation: Setelah should langsung bentuk dasar tanpa to: should see.

questions.prompt: Choose the best reply.
questions.explanation: Saran yang tepat untuk sakit gigi: You should see a dentist. Pilihan lain salah arti atau salah tata bahasa.

questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a question.
questions.explanation: What + should + I + do + about + masalah?

lessons.title: Have To and Don't Have To
lessons.summary: Membicarakan kewajiban dan hal yang tidak wajib dengan have to / don't have to.
objectives: Menggunakan have to / has to untuk kewajiban
Menggunakan don't / doesn't have to untuk hal yang tidak wajib
Menggunakan had to untuk kewajiban di masa lalu
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Have to = harus (karena keadaan)
Kita memakai **have to** untuk sesuatu yang **wajib** atau **perlu** dilakukan, sering karena **aturan, pekerjaan, atau keadaan**.

*I **have to** take this medicine three times a day.* (Saya harus minum obat ini tiga kali sehari — kata dokter.)

### Pola
Berbeda dengan should, **have to** berubah sesuai subjek, seperti kata kerja biasa:

| Bentuk | I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Positif | **have to** go | **has to** go |
| Negatif | **don't have to** go | **doesn't have to** go |
| Pertanyaan | **Do** you **have to** go? | **Does** she **have to** go? |
| Lampau | **had to** go | **had to** go |

Karena *have* adalah kata kerja biasa, negatif dan pertanyaannya memakai **do/does/did** (seperti di A1 dan Unit 3).

### Don't have to = tidak harus / tidak perlu
**Don't have to** berarti sesuatu **tidak wajib** — kamu boleh melakukannya atau tidak.

*Tomorrow is Sunday. I **don't have to** get up early.* (Saya tidak perlu bangun pagi.)

Hati-hati: *don't have to* **bukan** larangan. Artinya *tidak perlu*, bukan *tidak boleh*. (Larangan akan dipelajari di Lesson 4 dengan *mustn't*.)

### Had to untuk masa lalu
Bentuk lampau dari *have to* adalah **had to**:
- *Last week I **had to** stay in bed because I had the flu.*
- *Did you **have to** wait long at the clinic?* — *Yes, I had to wait two hours.*

### Should vs have to
| should | have to |
| --- | --- |
| saran — ide yang baik | kewajiban — tidak ada pilihan |
| *You should exercise more.* | *Nurses have to wear a uniform.* |

### Pelafalan
*Have to* sering diucapkan /ˈhæftə/ dan *has to* /ˈhæstə/ dalam percakapan cepat.

Subject + don't / doesn't have to + base verb

lessons.title: Must and Mustn't for Rules
lessons.summary: Memahami aturan dan larangan dengan must / mustn't serta membedakannya dari don't have to.
objectives: Menggunakan must untuk aturan dan mustn't untuk larangan
Membedakan mustn't (tidak boleh) dan don't have to (tidak perlu)
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Must = wajib (aturan)
**Must** dipakai untuk **aturan** atau kewajiban yang kuat, sering terlihat di tanda, peraturan, dan instruksi resmi.

*Visitors **must** wash their hands before entering.* (Pengunjung wajib mencuci tangan.)

### Mustn't = tidak boleh (larangan)
**Mustn't** (must not) /ˈmʌsnt/ berarti **dilarang**.

*You **mustn't** smoke in the hospital.* (Kamu tidak boleh merokok di rumah sakit.)

### Pola
| Bentuk | Pola | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Positif | subject + **must** + base verb | *You must wear a mask.* |
| Negatif | subject + **mustn't** + base verb | *You mustn't run.* |

Seperti should, **must** tidak berubah untuk he/she/it dan tidak memakai *to*: ✗ *He musts*, ✗ *must to wear*.

### Perbedaan PALING penting: mustn't vs don't have to
| mustn't | don't have to |
| --- | --- |
| **dilarang** — jangan lakukan! | **tidak perlu** — terserah kamu |
| *You mustn't eat in the library.* | *You don't have to bring a pen. We have pens.* |

Dalam bahasa Indonesia keduanya bisa diterjemahkan *tidak harus*, sehingga sering tertukar. Ingat:
- **mustn't** = *tidak boleh*
- **don't have to** = *tidak perlu*

### Must vs have to
Artinya mirip dalam kalimat positif. Secara umum:
- **must** sering dipakai untuk **aturan tertulis** dan perasaan pembicara sendiri: *I must call my mum tonight.*
- **have to** untuk kewajiban dari luar (pekerjaan, jadwal): *I have to work on Saturday.*

Untuk masa lalu, pakai **had to** (tidak ada *musted*).

### Tanda-tanda umum
| Tanda | Artinya |
| --- | --- |
| NO SMOKING | You mustn't smoke. |
| KEEP QUIET | You must be quiet. |
| STAFF ONLY | Visitors mustn't go in. |
| NO ENTRY | You mustn't enter. |

examples.en: Passengers must wear a seatbelt.
examples.id: Penumpang wajib memakai sabuk pengaman.

examples.en: You mustn't use your phone in the operating room.
examples.id: Kamu tidak boleh memakai ponsel di ruang operasi.

examples.en: You don't have to make an appointment. Just come in.
examples.id: Kamu tidak perlu membuat janji. Langsung datang saja.

examples.en: Children mustn't play near the pool without an adult.
examples.id: Anak-anak tidak boleh bermain di dekat kolam tanpa orang dewasa.

vocabulary.example: You must follow the hospital rules.
Smoking isn't allowed here.
You must wear a seatbelt.
Visitors mustn't enter after 8 p.m.
Patients must rest after the operation.

grammar.pattern: mustn't (tidak boleh) ≠ don't have to (tidak perlu)
grammar.example: You mustn't shout. / You don't have to come.

mistakes.wrong: You must to wear a seatbelt.
mistakes.why: Setelah must langsung bentuk dasar, tanpa to.

mistakes.right: It's free. You don't have to pay.
mistakes.why: Gratis berarti tidak perlu membayar (don't have to), bukan dilarang membayar.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I musted go to the doctor.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I had to go to the doctor.
mistakes.why: Must tidak punya bentuk lampau. Gunakan had to.

sections.summary: **must** = wajib (aturan), **mustn't** = **dilarang**. **don't have to** = **tidak perlu**. Must tidak berubah untuk he/she dan tidak memakai to. Untuk masa lalu pakai **had to**.

questions.prompt: You see a sign that says NO SMOKING. What does it mean?
options: You don't have to smoke here.
questions.explanation: Tanda larangan → mustn't (tidak boleh).
questions.misconception: Mengira don't have to juga berarti larangan.

questions.prompt: Match each sign with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Tanda larangan → mustn't; tanda perintah/aturan → must.

questions.prompt: Choose mustn't or don't have to.
questions.text: In the hospital you ___ run in the corridors, but you ___ wear a mask in the garden. It's optional there.
questions.explanation: Berlari di koridor dilarang → mustn't. Masker di taman opsional (tidak wajib) → don't have to.

questions.prompt: Which sentences mean 'It is NOT necessary'? Choose all correct answers.
options: You don't have to pay. It's free.
Students don't have to wear a tie on Fridays.
He doesn't have to work on Sundays.
questions.explanation: Don't/doesn't have to = tidak perlu. Mustn't = dilarang, jadi kalimat 2 dan 4 tidak termasuk.

questions.prompt: Correct the sentence.
questions.sentence: You must to wear a seatbelt in the car.
answers: You must wear a seatbelt in the car.
questions.explanation: Setelah must langsung bentuk dasar tanpa to.

questions.prompt: Complete with must or mustn't.
questions.text: It's a hospital rule: patients ___ eat or drink anything for six hours before an operation.
questions.explanation: Aturan rumah sakit yang melarang makan/minum → mustn't.

lessons.title: Healthy Habits and Visiting the Doctor
lessons.summary: Kosakata kebiasaan sehat, percakapan di klinik, dan memberi saran kesehatan.
objectives: Menggunakan kolokasi kebiasaan sehat: get enough sleep, do exercise, take medicine
Membuat janji dan menjelaskan gejala di klinik
Memahami instruksi obat dan saran dokter
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, coba latihan berbicara, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Kebiasaan sehat (healthy habits)
| Kolokasi | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| **get** enough sleep | cukup tidur |
| **do** exercise | berolahraga |
| **eat** fruit and vegetables | makan buah dan sayur |
| **drink** plenty of water | minum banyak air |
| **avoid** junk food | menghindari makanan cepat saji/tidak sehat |
| **stay up** late | begadang (kebiasaan buruk) |
| **take** medicine / vitamins | minum obat / vitamin |

Perhatikan: dalam bahasa Inggris kita **take** medicine, bukan ✗ *drink medicine* (kecuali obat cair).

### Di klinik
**Membuat janji (dengan resepsionis):**
- *Can I make an appointment with Dr. Rahma, please?*
- *Is tomorrow at ten OK?* — *Yes, that's fine.*

**Menjelaskan gejala (dengan dokter):**
- *I have a bad cough and a sore throat.*
- *It started three days ago.* (Mulai tiga hari yang lalu.)
- *I feel tired all the time.*

**Saran dan instruksi dokter:**
- *You should rest for two days.*
- *You have to take these tablets three times a day.*
- *You mustn't drive after taking this medicine.*
- *You don't have to come back if you feel better.*

### Memahami label obat
| Instruksi | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| Take two tablets three times a day. | Minum 2 tablet, 3x sehari. |
| after meals | sesudah makan |
| before meals | sebelum makan |
| Do not exceed the stated dose. | Jangan melebihi dosis. |

### Prescription dan pharmacy
Dokter memberi **prescription** (resep), lalu kamu mengambil obat di **pharmacy** (apotek). *The doctor gave me a prescription, and I took it to the pharmacy.*

### Menggabungkan semua modal
Unit ini mengajarkan empat cara berbicara tentang kewajiban dan saran:

| Modal | Fungsi |
| --- | --- |
| should | saran (ide baik) |
| have to / must | wajib |
| don't have to | tidak perlu |
| mustn't | dilarang |

examples.en: You should get at least seven hours of sleep.
examples.id: Sebaiknya kamu tidur setidaknya tujuh jam.

examples.en: Can I make an appointment with Dr. Rahma, please?
examples.id: Bisakah saya membuat janji dengan Dr. Rahma?

examples.en: The cough started four days ago.
examples.id: Batuknya mulai empat hari yang lalu.

examples.en: Take one tablet twice a day after meals.
examples.id: Minum satu tablet dua kali sehari sesudah makan.

vocabulary.example: The doctor wrote a prescription for me.
You can buy this at the pharmacy.
What are your symptoms?
You should avoid junk food.
Avoid cold drinks when you have a sore throat.

grammar.pattern: Can I make an appointment with + name?
grammar.example: Can I make an appointment with the dentist?

grammar.pattern: Take + number + tablet(s) + frequency + after/before meals
grammar.example: Take two tablets twice a day before meals.

mistakes.wrong: I drink medicine three times a day.
mistakes.right: I take medicine three times a day.

mistakes.wrong: I go to the pharmacy to see the doctor.
mistakes.right: I go to the clinic to see the doctor.
mistakes.why: Pharmacy = apotek (membeli obat); dokter ada di clinic/hospital.

sections.summary: Kebiasaan sehat: **get enough sleep, do exercise, drink plenty of water, avoid junk food, take medicine**. Di klinik: buat janji (*Can I make an appointment...?*), jelaskan gejala, dan pahami saran dokter dengan **should, have to, must, mustn't, don't have to**.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: The doctor gave me a ___ for some medicine, and I took it to the pharmacy.
questions.explanation: Kertas dari dokter yang dibawa ke apotek = prescription (resep).

questions.prompt: Your friend says: 'I always feel tired, I have headaches, and I can't sleep well.' Give your friend advice for 30–45 seconds. Use should, shouldn't and at least one healthy-habit phrase.
questions.sampleAnswer: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. I think you should get enough sleep, maybe eight hours a night. You shouldn't stay up late or use your phone in bed. You should drink plenty of water and do some exercise, like walking in the morning. And you shouldn't drink coffee in the evening. If the headaches don't stop, you should see a doctor.
questions.explanation: Mulai dengan simpati (I'm sorry to hear that), beri beberapa saran dengan should/shouldn't, dan akhiri dengan saran ke dokter jika perlu.

questions.prompt: Read the medicine label. Which sentence is true?
questions.context: **FLUAWAY tablets** — Take two tablets three times a day after meals. Do not drive after taking this medicine. Drink plenty of water. Keep away from children.
options: You must take the tablets after eating.
You should take the tablets before breakfast.
You can drive after taking the medicine.
You have to take one tablet a day.
questions.explanation: Label: after meals (sesudah makan). Dilarang menyetir, dan dosisnya dua tablet tiga kali sehari.

questions.prompt: Match the verbs with the words that go with them.
questions.explanation: Kolokasi: get enough sleep, do exercise, take medicine, make an appointment, stay up late.

questions.prompt: Complete the doctor's advice. Use must, mustn't or don't have to.
questions.text: You ___ stay in bed for two days — that's very important. You ___ go back to work before Monday. And you ___ come back next week if you feel better.
questions.explanation: Sangat penting → must. Dilarang kembali bekerja sebelum Senin → mustn't. Tidak perlu kembali jika sudah sembuh → don't have to.

questions.prompt: Choose the best line for the patient.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Of course. Is tomorrow at ten OK?

options: Good morning. Can I make an appointment with Dr. Rahma, please?
questions.explanation: Resepsionis menawarkan waktu (tomorrow at ten), jadi pasien pasti meminta janji temu.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the best option: A: I feel really tired every morning. B: You ___ go to bed earlier.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Saran yang baik untuk orang yang lelah: tidur lebih awal → should.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete with the correct form of have to.
unitTestQuestions.text: Last week I was ill, so I ___ stay in bed for three days.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Kewajiban di masa lalu → had to.

unitTestQuestions.text: In this library you ___ eat or drink, but you ___ be a member to read the books here.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Makan/minum dilarang → mustn't. Tidak perlu menjadi anggota → don't have to.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Setelah doesn't, gunakan bentuk dasar: doesn't have to.

unitTestQuestions.source: Sebaiknya kamu tidak makan terlalu banyak gula.
answers: You shouldn't eat too much sugar.
You should not eat too much sugar.
You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
You should not eat so much sugar.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Sebaiknya tidak = shouldn't. Terlalu banyak gula = too much sugar (sugar tak terhitung → much).

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Match each modal with its meaning.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: must = wajib, mustn't = dilarang, don't have to = tidak perlu, should = saran.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the best word: I have a high ___. It's 39 degrees.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: 39 derajat menunjukkan suhu tubuh tinggi → a high temperature (demam).
